questions.question: What did God ask Abraham to offer as a sacrifice?
options: A ram caught in the thicket

questions.question: What did God provide as a substitute for Isaac?
options: A ram caught in a thicket
A goat tangled in the brush
A lamb from a nearby flock
A bird snared in the bushes
questions.answer: A ram caught in a thicket

questions.question: An angel of the LORD stopped Abraham just before he sacrificed Isaac.
God told Abraham to go to the region of _____ to offer Isaac.
Abraham named the place "The LORD will _____."
